title: The Eagle and the Beetle

full_text:
A hare fled from an eagle and sought refuge with a humble dung beetle. The beetle pleaded for the hare's life, but the haughty eagle struck the beetle aside with her wing and devoured the hare.

The beetle sought revenge: whenever the eagle laid eggs in high nests, the beetle flew up and rolled the eggs out, smashing them upon the rocks.

Even when the eagle laid her eggs in the lap of the celestial ruler, the beetle dropped a pellet of dirt, causing the sovereign to rise and accidentally smash the eggs, proving that contempt for the weak brings inescapable justice.
moral: Never despise the smallest enemy when justice is on his side.
